_about: Zuhayr Creative Z-only mark as a folded-metal sculpture. Traced by the lead from refs/brand/z-mark-flat-facets.png (8 facets, 180-degree rotational symmetry, symmetrised). Units: metres, origin = centre of the mark, +y up, +z toward the viewer. Height 1.298 m, width 1.482 m. The bottom half is the top half rotated 180 degrees about the z axis: (x, y, z) -> (-x, -y, z).
